title: Getting TSA PreCheck Before the Holiday Travel Rush
summary: Traveling for the holidays? Use this TSA PreCheck guide to learn how to apply, what to bring to your appointment, and how to add your KTN
body_markdown:
**Summary:** Traveling for the holidays? Use this TSA PreCheck guide to learn how to apply, what to bring to your appointment and how to add your KTN to a flight reservation.


Holiday travel often means busy airports, packed schedules and a lot to keep track of. One practical gift you can give yourself before the holidays is TSA PreCheck®. It can make airport security screening more convenient, and[enrollment is a quick process](https://tsaprecheckbytelos.tsa.dhs.gov/app/apply-for-tsa-precheck) .


### How to get TSA PreCheck before holiday travel


Telos is an authorized TSA PreCheck enrollment provider, offering enrollment at over 500 locations nationwide, including at Office Depot® OfficeMax® and USPS® retail locations.


To enroll through Telos,[complete the online application](https://tsaprecheckbytelos.tsa.dhs.gov/app/apply-for-tsa-precheck) and schedule an in-person appointment at an enrollment location. The online application takes about five minutes; the appointment takes less than 10 minutes and includes document scanning, a photo, fingerprinting and payment.


Most applicants receive their Known Traveler Number (KTN) in 3–5 days, though some applications can take up to 60 days. Since processing times can vary, apply as early as possible before your trip. TSA makes the final eligibility decision.


### What should I bring to my TSA PreCheck appointment?


Bring the identity and citizenship or immigration documents required for your application, plus an accepted payment method. If your name differs across documents, bring legal documents showing the name change. Check[TSA’s document and appointment guidance](https://www.tsa.gov/precheck/required-identification) before you go; missing or mismatched documents can require a new appointment.


### How do I schedule an appointment?


Start by selecting[a convenient TSA PreCheck enrollment by Telos location](https://tsaprecheckbytelos.tsa.dhs.gov/tsa-precheck-locations) . Telos offers enrollment at more than 500 locations nationwide, including participating neighborhood Office Depot and OfficeMax stores and USPS locations.


**Holiday Tip:** Have holiday shopping to finish? After completing your TSA PreCheck enrollment at a participating Office Depot or OfficeMax store, you’ll receive an in-store coupon for $10 off a purchase of $20 or more – which can be used on great holiday gifts from brands like LEGO and Needoh.


### How do I add my KTN to my airline booking?


After you receive your KTN, add it to each flight reservation – either when booking or through the airline’s website, app, or customer service. Enter your name and date of birth exactly as they appear in your enrollment information. Check your boarding pass for the TSA PreCheck indicator; a KTN alone does not provide access to the TSA PreCheck lane if the indicator is missing from your boarding pass.


In addition, at participating airlines and airports, eligible TSA PreCheck travelers may also be able to opt in to[TSA PreCheck Touchless ID](https://www.telos.com/blog/2026/08/18/tsa-precheck-touchless-id-everything-you-need-to-know/) , which uses facial comparison for identity verification in a dedicated lane. Availability and eligibility requirements apply, so check with your airline before travel.


Searching for a TSA PreCheck fast track before the holidays? Start with this TSA PreCheck guide: apply early, prepare your documents, schedule an appointment and add your KTN to your airline bookings. A little preparation can help make the airport security part of your holiday trip feel easier.
